{{Top}}
[[File:Technicians-EotECR.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and [[Human/Legends|Human]] technician]]
{{Quote|Good mechanics can repair and maintain ships.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="FOJ">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>}}
'''Technicians''', also called '''technos''', '''technicos''', or '''mechanics''', were people who were skilled in making, fixing and understanding technology. Almost every urban area had some technicians employed at factories, shops and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and only the most primitive civilizations went without one.

==Description==
Technicians could found working in almost any technical field throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Hands-on technicians were responsible for maintaining systems aboard [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and colonies, while others were more involved in the planning side, working as technical planners for [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. Technicians also served on [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and could often be found as part of a [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] crew where they kept the vessel operational by any means necessary. Experienced technicians often moved on to lucrative roles, such as being [[Chief engineer/Legends|chief engineers]] on larger ships or space stations, or even moving in a designer role with large [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporations]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] mechanics were largely unsung geniuses that could exploit the powerful machines to their fullest capacities.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

The [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Rorand Zuzz]] was a technician who specialized in medical technology.<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Endicott/Legends|Endicott]] served as a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] technician aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="Death Star II">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Endicott}}</ref>
